name: BBC micro:bit V2
description: Classroom board with nRF52833 (BLE 5.1), 5x5 LED matrix, accelerometer/compass, microphone, speaker, touch logo and an edge connector, programmed by USB drag-and-drop.
notes: A KL27Z interface chip provides DAPLink drag-and-drop programming and USB serial; the nRF52833's own USB is not wired out.

Edge connector has 25 pads: 3 large rings (P0-P2) plus 3V and GND, and 1.27 mm pitch small pads; 19 GPIO are available but several are shared with the LED matrix and buttons (P3, P4, P6, P7, P10 and P5, P11).
On board: LSM303AGR accelerometer/magnetometer, MEMS microphone, speaker, capacitive touch logo, 5x5 LED matrix, 2 buttons and a 2-pin JST battery connector.
Programmed with MakeCode, MicroPython and Rust (CircuitPython/Arduino via community ports); I/O is 3.3 V.
